blurb: Guests can rent various boats including pontoons and deck boats equipped for tubing, tanning, and cruising. The marina offers a full-service RV park with electric and full hookup sites. Amenities include a waterfront restaurant, ship's store, private fishing lounge, and concierge boat services.
extraNote: RV site stay requires prepayment · 48 hour cancellation notice required for RV site refund · $44 non-refundable damage waiver fee required on all motorized boat rentals · No grills or glass containers allowed on rental boats
